title: Make UI V2 chat-first and add independent editable User and Agent avatars
goal: Present UI V2 as a focused messaging app with the chat screen as the primary surface, hide secondary Tasks/Settings/workspace navigation, keep profile and appearance controls behind the top-right avatar, and allow independently editable User and Agent avatars.
context: Follow-up to PAUI-003. User explicitly asked to edit both Agent and User photos because the UI changes felt too small. Keep the changes presentation-only and preserve the UI V2 opt-in flag. Latest product direction: show only the messaging-chat experience by default; secondary information must stay out of the main interface and be reachable only when explicitly opened.
forbidden_changes: Do not alter Agent Runtime, policies, permissions, provider routing, workspace execution, or conversation persistence.
Do not reuse profile.avatar.data for the Agent; profile.agentAvatar.data is a separate local setting.
Do not decode image bytes for every message render or streaming token update.
Do not remove UI V2 opt-in or change the V1 default.
acceptance_criteria: UI V2 opens directly into ChatScreen with no bottom tab bar, Tasks/Settings tabs, or workspace button visible.
Profile/avatar and appearance controls remain reachable from a compact top-right avatar button; profile is not a primary navigation destination.
The chat remains the primary screen; secondary information is hidden unless explicitly opened.
Profile allows choosing a User avatar and a separate Agent avatar.
Agent avatar can be replaced and reset to the themed fallback.
User messages display profile.avatar.data and Agent replies, including streaming replies, display profile.agentAvatar.data.
Avatar changes refresh without restarting the app and persist locally.
Images are resized/compressed before persistence and missing images use accessible fallbacks.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA are checked on the exact PR head.
Physical-device visual behavior is reported separately from CI.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA on the exact PR head.
recovery: Revert the Agent avatar state and rendering independently if a regression appears; preserve the existing User profile avatar and UI V2 toggle.
